# ARK Experience (ARKE)

> Digital guides for natural body care you can make at home, by Yana in Phuket, Thailand. Tested formulas explained in plain language, for curious beginners who would rather make something with their hands than scroll.

ARK Experience is a personal project that shares educational PDF guides. Each formula is made and used daily by Yana, her family and friends in Phuket's year-round heat. Formula amounts and percentages are only inside the guides. The guides are for education and personal use, not medical advice.

## Free guides

- [Beginner's Guide to Natural Body Care](https://www.arkarkark.com/guide-beginners): 16 pages on reading ingredient labels, what natural means, seeing through claims and myths, and taking a first step into making your own body care.
- [Making Natural Lip Balm at Home](https://www.arkarkark.com/guide-lip-balm): 15 pages with one tested lip balm formula, explained ingredient by ingredient. Twenty minutes, twenty tubes.

## Paid guides (USD 12.99 each, instant PDF)

- [Natural Deodorant Guide](https://www.arkarkark.com/guide-deodorant): a baking-soda-free natural deodorant stick, tested daily in Phuket's heat and explained ingredient by ingredient.
- [Shampoo Bars Guide](https://www.arkarkark.com/guide-shampoo-bars): gentle solid shampoo bars made without lye, with one tested rosemary and calendula formula, explained phase by phase.
- [Whipped Body Butter Guide](https://www.arkarkark.com/guide-body-butter): whipped body butter made at home, with the science of butters, oils and wax and the cooling and whipping technique.
- [Oil Infusions for Hair & Body](https://www.arkarkark.com/guide-oil-infusions): infusing botanicals into oil for hair and body, with every method, drying, straining, storage and two ARKE formulas.
